## PR description ### [Bugfix] Qwen-Image-Layered: allow layers=2 to match upstream demo [labels: ready] ## Purpose Fixes #4776. The OpenAI image endpoint (`/v1/images/edits` and the diffusion chat path) returns HTTP 400 for `layers=2` against `Qwen/Qwen-Image-Layered`: ``` Invalid layers value 2. layers must be between 3 and 10 inclusive. ``` The lower bound is hard-coded in [`vllm_omni/entrypoints/openai/image_api_utils.py:17`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/main/vllm_omni/entrypoints/openai/image_api_utils.py#L17): ```python SUPPORTED_LAYERED_LAYERS_RANGE = range(3, 11) ``` This range was introduced by #2334 / #2349 in response to #2331 (`layers=1000` OOM). The **upper** bound `10` is a sensible OOM guard, but the lower bound `3` has no documented justification and is **stricter than upstream**: the official Qwen-Image-Layered Gradio demo ([`QwenLM/Qwen-Image-Layered/src/app.py`](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Image-Layered/blob/main/src/app.py)) defines the layers slider with `minimum=2, maximum=10`. The pipeline implementation in vllm-omni ([`pipeline_qwen_image_layered.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/main/vllm_omni/diffusion/models/qwen_image/pipeline_qwen_image_layered.py)) also treats `layers` symbolically with no `layers >= 3` assertion. As a side effect, #2350 had to bump the `layers_guard_001` regression test from `layers=2` to `layers=3` solely to satisfy this gate, losing the original `layers=2` coverage from #1969. This PR restores that coverage. ## Changes - `vllm_omni/entrypoints/openai/image_api_utils.py`: `range(3, 11)` → `range(2, 11)`. - `vllm_omni/entrypoints/openai/protocol/images.py`: `Field(description="Supported range: 3-10.")` → `2-10`. - `tests/entrypoints/openai_api/test_image_server.py`: shift the lower-bound rejection cases from `layers=2` to `layers=1` and update the expected error string to `"between 2 and 10 inclusive"`. - `tests/e2e/online_serving/test_qwen_image_layered_expansion.py`: revert the `layers_guard_001` param from `3` back to `2` (undoing #2350's gate-driven bump). Issue #1969's original coverage at `layers=2` is restored. Upper bound `10` (OOM guard) is preserved. ## Test Plan Local repro against the released wheel before the fix (`vllm-omni==0.22.0`, PyPI): ```python import importlib.util, pathlib import vllm_omni target = pathlib.Path(vllm_omni.__file__).parent / "entrypoints/openai/image_api_utils.py" spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("iau", target) mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod) print(mod.SUPPORTED_LAYERED_LAYERS_RANGE) for n in (1, 2, 3, 10, 11): try: print(f"layers={n}: OK -> {mod.validate_layered_layers(n)}") except ValueError as e: print(f"layers={n}: RAISED {e}") ``` Before: ``` range(3, 11) layers=1: RAISED Invalid layers value 1. layers must be between 3 and 10 inclusive. layers=2: RAISED Invalid layers value 2. layers must be between 3 and 10 inclusive. layers=3: OK -> 3 layers=10: OK -> 10 layers=11: RAISED Invalid layers value 11. layers must be between 3 and 10 inclusive. ``` After this PR (constant flipped to `range(2, 11)`): ``` range(2, 11) layers=1: RAISED Invalid layers value 1. layers must be between 2 and 10 inclusive. layers=2: OK -> 2 layers=3: OK -> 3 layers=10: OK -> 10 layers=11: RAISED Invalid layers value 11. layers must be between 2 and 10 inclusive. ``` Unit test coverage: - `tests/entrypoints/openai_api/test_image_server.py::test_parameter_validation` — pydantic-level boundary (`layers=1` and `layers=11` raise). - `tests/entrypoints/openai_api/test_image_server.py::test_image_edit_invalid_layers` — HTTP 400 on `layers=1` / `layers=11` with the new "2 and 10 inclusive" message. I do not have access to an H100 host, so I have not run the L2 regression `tests/e2e/online_serving/test_qwen_image_layered_expansion.py::layers_guard_001` (single-card H100, full-model). The change to that file is the minimal value/id rewind from `3` → `2`; CI is requested for L2 confirmation when the `ready` label is added. ## Linked issue #4776: [Bug]: Qwen-Image-Layered API rejects `layers=2`, but the upstream demo allows it (min should be 2, not 3) ### Your current environment
